typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant - highly legible sans paired with dense monospace for forensics.

hierarchy.micro_label: text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-sans text-zinc-500 font-semibold

layouts.page: flex flex-col h-screen overflow-hidden bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-50 font-sans
layouts.header: flex h-14 items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 shrink-0 bg-zinc-950 z-20
layouts.swimlane: flex-1 min-h-[100px] border-b border-zinc-800 relative group flex
layouts.swimlane_header: w-32 shrink-0 border-r border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/50 p-2 flex flex-col justify-center items-end text-right z-10
layouts.drawer: w-[380px] shrink-0 border-l border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 flex flex-col transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out z-30 overflow-y-auto

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: The 'Technical Grid' - expose the skeleton, sharp 1px borders, minimal radii (max 4px). NO glassmorphism. Solid tactical panels.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG grid background pattern in the timeline track to simulate a forensic cutting mat/graph paper.
visual_enhancers.nodes: Dense, highly legible pills. 28px height. Border-left accented with lane color. Solid zinc-900 bg.
visual_enhancers.mitre_chip: Absolute positioned, top -8px, right -4px. text-[9px] bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-700 rounded-sm px-1 font-mono z-10 shadow-sm
visual_enhancers.spawn_arcs: SVG overlays connecting nodes. Use stroke-zinc-600 stroke-dasharray-4. Highlight to amber-500 on node hover.

HeaderMetaBar.description: Top bar containing case ID, event count, and V2 badge.
HeaderMetaBar.v2_badge: px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 border border-amber-500/20 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(245,158,11,0.1)]
HeaderMetaBar.search: relative max-w-sm w-full ml-auto. Shadcn Input tailored with mono font, bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-700 focus:border-amber-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500

TimelineAxis.description: Sticky bottom ruler. Real UTC markings.
TimelineAxis.classes: h-10 border-t border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 flex items-center px-4 text-xs font-mono text-zinc-500 relative shrink-0
TimelineAxis.tick_marks: Absolute positioned vertical 1px lines mapping to time units.

EventNode.description: DENSE nodes representing individual events in a swimlane.
EventNode.classes: absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-7 min-w-[140px] max-w-[280px] bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-sm flex items-center pl-2 pr-3 cursor-pointer transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-zinc-500 hover:z-20

RightDrawer.description: Case overview (empty state) or Event Evidence panel (populated state).
RightDrawer.empty_state_sections: MITRE Tactics Hit, Top Entities, Event Breakdown, Narrative. Use dense tabular layouts.
RightDrawer.evidence_panel: Rule ID, source, confidence, artifact refs, ATT&CK mapping, exact command / process ancestry.

TrainingNoteCTA.description: Floating action button for analyst annotations.
TrainingNoteCTA.classes: fixed bottom-14 right-[400px] bg-amber-500 text-amber-950 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-sm font-semibold text-xs shadow-lg flex items-center gap-2 hover:bg-amber-400 z-40 transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-amber-300/50

motion.node_hover: transition: transform 0.15s ease-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease

accessibility.keyboard: Implement ← / → keydown listeners for node step-through. `/` key to focus search input. `Esc` to close drawer.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic UI layouts. This must look like a high-density forensic terminal.
USE 'IBM Plex Sans' for normal text and 'IBM Plex Mono' for ALL data points, timestamps, commands, and IDs. Add @import to load these from Google Fonts.
Enforce strict 1px borders using zinc-800 for the grid structure. NO rounded soft cards. Use 'rounded-sm' (max 4px radius).
Ensure nodes represent actual items. Use fixed height/width absolute positioning relative to their time axis in the swimlanes to mimic a proper Gantt/Timeline chart.
Draw SVG lines (spawn arcs) between parent and child nodes using standard path definitions (e.g. `<svg><path ... /></svg>`) bridging between coordinates. Mock the visual representation clearly.
For icons: Use lucide-react. Map specific icons to rows: SYSTEM (Cpu), PROCESS (Activity), FILES (FileCode), NETWORK (Globe), REGISTRY (Database).
The drawer state MUST switch entirely between Case Overview and Evidence Panel depending on selection state.
Implement data-testid on every clickable or interactive node.
Ensure dark colors are strictly derived from the zinc palette for backgrounds, avoiding all cyans or teals completely.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use completely transparent backgrounds over content.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Add Transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
Always use specific properties for transitions (NOT transition: all).
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements include a data-testid attribute.
